title: Why the future is local app
summary: This article discusses the growing trend toward local-first applications, arguing that local/desktop software offers advantages in privacy, performance, offline capability, and user control compared to cloud-dependent services. The author makes a case for why software that runs locally on user devices represents the future of computing.
problem_solved: Addresses the issues of privacy concerns, dependency on internet connectivity, and reduced user control inherent in cloud-based software.
why_valuable: It provides perspective on an emerging architectural shift in software development toward local-first approaches, which is increasingly relevant as users become more concerned about data privacy and service availability.
